handoff.currentState: The eight-rule deterministic domain layer, hidden-character debut contract and conditional ending epilogues are the current dual-deployment release. Production and GitHub Pages are built from the same source release.
latestFixes: Eight local rules atomically govern starter repair, route commitment, fuel search, station aid and three Master Switch Key overrides.
Governed turns reject all model protocol commands, including choices, and install feasible success or recovery choices locally.
Rejected governed actions make zero state changes and do not advance the danger clock.
Master Switch Key remaining uses derive from one persisted use counter instead of a second mutable count.
Doctor Ren, Lin and Mako remain outside the roster until a visible authored character update introduces their stable IDs.
Ending epilogues only require authored characters that actually exist in the immutable ending snapshot.
handoff.saveCompatibility: Existing saves remain compatible. Legacy saves that preloaded hidden characters without a visible introduction are normalized by removing those entries unless the character is visible in story blocks, the party, relationships or an authored update.
nextChecks: Extend deterministic rules only for later actions that mutate scarce resources, one-time rewards, route locks or permanent costs.
Preserve browser coverage for route rejection before repair, exact Condition +5 settlement and duplicate repair rejection.
When adding a new hidden companion, include a visible-form introduction and a character-debut regression test.
